details: renderNodes() calls gMain.selectAll('*').remove() and rebuilds the entire SVG DOM on every d3.timer tick (~60fps) during the 650ms collapse/expand animation — a classic update storm; the tension slider also triggers a full computeLinks() + canvas redraw on every input event with no RAF or debounce.
